name: rushikeshmore-codecortex
description: Persistent codebase knowledge layer for AI coding agents. Pre-digests codebases into structured knowledge (symbols, dependency graphs, co-change patterns, architectural decisions) via tree-sitter native parsing (28 languages) and serves via MCP. 14 tools, ~85% token reduction. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any MCP client.
